text: BAM share fell 1.41 percentage points over 20 hours, and is down 1.14 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 36.3% of all Solana stake routed through BAM. The 66 top-node leadership changes in this window fit whale-driven routing, not structural rollover; only one structural rollover has been validated, in fra on 2026-06-24.
